decision: Keep the unchanged public-split candidate for qualification; freeze one short A lifecycle validity gate and one conditional four-hour B continuous diagnostic.
rationale: The split learner has one B primary; earlier full lifecycle studies use other implementations.
One continuous fresh stream carries plant, learner, RNG, input index and predictive weights without an unsupported old-checkpoint/source bridge.
Separate prompt SOC, cumulative capacity acquisition, weak-use retention and renewed-excitation observations; capacity has no startup deadline.
All-sample Q/SOC scores and causal forecast instrumentation prevent sparse-query or post-fit metrics from concealing relevant errors.
admission_scope: A validity failures block B. A accuracy remains observational for admission to this diagnostic, is fully preserved, and still blocks broader usefulness/campaign qualification when it misses. This is not a waiver for day/week/annual work.
retention_rule: A hard/preferred target must pass on entry and throughout its declared window. If not acquired at entry, report that separately. Within-target drift is not failure; an already preferred estimate need not improve further.
not_established: Any new accuracy or retention outcome
Whether time alone or renewed stimulus causes improvement

next.action: Implement frozen host harness and bounded preflight, freeze/review executable receipt, then execute the staged contract once if its gates pass.

stop: Design task is complete. Do not run a primary, generate its noise or change the learner here. In implementation, stop at the frozen staged result or first validity/budget failure; no adaptive rerun or automatic duration extension.
